title: DocumentUploaded (v1)
description: A document's bytes are in the quarantine prefix and its identity is known. Written by the ingest function after validate → hash → record. Starts the pipeline.

source.description: Only these services may write DocumentUploaded.

data.description: Only facts a consumer needs to act; nothing that can be looked up. Unknown fields tolerated (additive v1).

key.description: Object key (under the quarantine prefix until indexed).

size_bytes.description: Object size; the upload size limit is enforced before this event exists.

content_type.description: MIME type as validated by ingest (e.g. application/pdf, text/markdown).

sha256.description: sha256 of the bytes. Equals the envelope's doc_id on purpose: a consumer can verify what it fetched.
